WEDNESDAY · JULY 8, 2026

Wheels Up — Into the Berkshires

DFW → Boston Logan → Stockbridge, MA
✈ DL2351 · 7:15 AM DFW→BOS
🚗 Boston→Stockbridge ~2.5 hrs · I-90 West
🏛️ Overnight: Red Lion Inn

🗺 Along the Way — Suggested Stops

Natick/Framingham
First Mass Pike exit worth a stop — Wegmans for road snacks, Starbucks drive-through.
Rest Stop · 30 min from Logan
Lee, MA
Charming Berkshires gateway town. Prime Roast Beef & Seafood for a quick lunch, or Cakewalk for coffee.

Day Schedule

7:15 AM

Delta DL2351 — Depart DFW

Seats 26A/26B · Conf: F6BVFX. ~3.5 hour flight. The approach into Logan over Boston Harbor is beautiful on a clear day — look left.

FLIGHT
12:08 PM

Pick Up the Mercedes at Logan

Collect the 2023 C-Class from Turo host (plate 5YJP45). Take I-90 West — the Mass Pike — through the eastern suburbs and into the gorgeous Berkshire hills.

CAR PICKUP~2.5 HRS TO STOCKBRIDGE
~3:00 PM

Norman Rockwell Museum

The trip's first must-see. World's largest Rockwell collection — 998 works. His actual studio on-site, preserved exactly as he left it the day he died in 1978. Plan 2–3 hours. Last entry ~4:30 PM.

MUST-SEE #1
Evening

Stroll Stockbridge Main Street

The literal street Rockwell painted for his famous 1967 "Christmas" scene. Unchanged storefronts, white-steeple churches, elm-lined sidewalks — completely timeless.

EXPLORE
Dinner

Red Lion Inn Dining Room

Fine linens, James Beard-honored kitchen. Widow Bingham's Tavern downstairs is cozier and equally good. Cocktails on the famous rocking-chair porch after.

THURSDAY · JULY 9, 2026

Through the Hudson Valley

Stockbridge, MA → Albany, NY
🚗 ~1.5 hrs · US-20 West scenic route recommended
📍 Overnight: 1874 Row House Airbnb · Albany

🗺 Along the Way — Suggested Stops

Pittsfield, MA
Largest Berkshires city. The Marketplace Café or Dottie's Coffee Lounge for a mid-morning break.
Berkshires · 20 min from Stockbridge
Hancock Shaker Village
Remarkable 1790s Shaker community museum on US-20. The round stone barn is stunning. 45 min visit.
Historic · US-20 · Optional
Hudson, NY
Increasingly hip river town with excellent antique shops, galleries, and the outstanding restaurant Swoon Kitchenbar.
Hudson Valley · 30 min south

Day Schedule

Morning

Breakfast at the Red Lion Inn

Start with breakfast in the dining room or coffee on the porch. The inn is at its best before the day-trippers arrive.

DINING
Mid-Morning

Scenic Drive West to Albany

Take US-20 through Pittsfield and Hancock rather than the highway — beautiful Berkshire foothills and Hudson Valley transition. Albany sits where the Hudson and Mohawk Rivers meet.

~1.5 HRS · US-20 SCENIC
Afternoon

Check In — 1874 Historic Row House

128 Grand Street. Approach via Governor's Mansion / Eagle Street (host Phat's GPS note). Heart of Albany's finest historic district — Gilded Age brownstones.

AIRBNB · HM5PHWNKY2
Afternoon

Washington Park & Center Square

90-acre Victorian park by Olmsted's firm — same team as Central Park. Lake, rose gardens, period lamp posts. Center Square neighborhood has Albany's finest row houses.

EASY WALKING
Evening

Dinner on Lark Street

Café Capriccio (beloved since 1981, James Beard-recognized Italian) or Chez Mike (farm-to-table, excellent wine list). Both 10–15 min from Grand Street.

Graduation Day — Celebrate!

Albany, NY — The Big Milestone
🎓 No driving today — stay in Albany

Day Schedule

Morning

Graduation Ceremony

The whole point of Albany. Take it all in — the ceremony, the photos, the pride. Albany's historic surroundings make for a remarkable backdrop for this milestone.

MILESTONE
Afternoon

Celebration Lunch or Dinner

New World Bistro Bar for inventive cuisine, or The Hollow Bar + Kitchen in a stunning converted Victorian firehouse. Either is special-occasion worthy.

CELEBRATION DINING

NY State Capitol — Optional

10-min walk from Grand Street. The 1899 masterpiece took 32 years to build. Free tours. The Million Dollar Staircase is extraordinary.

OPTIONAL

Unwind in your Gilded Age surroundings. Pack up tonight — tomorrow goes Albany → Hartford → Hampton, the longest driving day of the trip.

SATURDAY · JULY 11, 2026

Twain, Coastline & the Old Salt

Albany → Hartford, CT → Hampton, NH
🚗 Albany→Hartford ~2.5 hrs · I-90 E / I-84 S
🚗 Hartford→Hampton ~2.5 hrs · I-91 N / I-95 N
📍 Overnight: Lamie's Inn · Hampton NH

🗺 Along the Way — Suggested Stops

Northampton, MA
Charming Pioneer Valley college town. Short detour on I-91 N. Thornes Marketplace for coffee, excellent downtown.
Pioneer Valley · I-91 N · Optional
Brattleboro, VT
On I-91 heading north — worth a 30-min stop. Great bookstore (Brattleboro Books), waterfront park, local cafés.
Vermont Detour · Off I-91
Kittery, ME
First Maine exit on I-95. Warren's Lobster House is iconic. Maine Welcome Center is free and has the best blueberry pie you'll ever eat.
Maine Gateway · I-95 N

Day Schedule

8:00 AM

Depart Albany — South to Hartford

I-90 East then I-84 South through Connecticut. ~2.5 hrs. Mark Twain House opens at 9:30 AM — morning arrival is ideal.

DRIVE ~2.5 HRS
~10:30 AM

Mark Twain House & Museum

The ornate Victorian Gothic mansion where Twain wrote Huckleberry Finn, Tom Sawyer, and Connecticut Yankee. Guided tours are outstanding — Twain's personality fills every room. BUY TICKETS ONLINE first.

MUST-SEE · BUY TICKETS IN ADVANCE
1:00 PM

Quick Lunch in Hartford

Tisane Euro-Asian Café on Farmington Ave near the museum is excellent. Or grab something light and keep moving.

LUNCH
2:00 PM

Drive North to Hampton, NH

I-91 North through the Connecticut River Valley, then I-95 North along the coast. Watch for the Piscataqua Bridge — the moment you cross into New Hampshire.

DRIVE ~2.5 HRS
Evening

Check In & Dinner at Old Salt

Lamie's Inn since 1740. The Old Salt attached is the destination — classic New England seafood, nautical décor, genuine tradition. Get the chowder. The lobster dinner is outstanding.

SUNDAY · JULY 12, 2026

Into Maine — The Quiet Side

Hampton, NH → Southwest Harbor, ME
🚗 ~4.5 hrs · I-95 N to Portland then Rte 1/3 to MDI
⏰ Check-in 4:00–8:00 PM — aim to arrive by 5 PM

🗺 Along the Way — Suggested Stops

Kennebunkport, ME
Classic coastal Maine town worth a 30-min stop. Dock Square, Mabel's Lobster Claw, Bush family church views.
Scenic Stop · ~1.5 hrs from Hampton
Portland, ME
Maine's best food city. Old Port district for lunch — Eventide Oyster Co. is outstanding. Worth an hour.
Food Stop · ~2.5 hrs from Hampton
Wiscasset, ME
The "Prettiest Village in Maine." Red's Eats lobster roll is legendary (expect a line — worth it). On Route 1.
Lobster Roll · Route 1 Detour

Day Schedule

Morning

Continental Breakfast & Depart

Lamie's Inn includes breakfast. Today's the longest drive (~4.5 hrs). Aim to leave by 9 AM — check-in window opens at 4 PM.

INCLUDEDDEPART BY 9 AM
Mid-Morning

The Maine Coast Begins

Cross the Piscataqua into Maine and you'll know immediately — the light changes, pines crowd the road, and the air smells of brine. Pull over at the Maine Welcome Center in Kittery.

SCENIC — PULL OVER OFTEN
Midday

Portland or Route 1 Lunch Stop

Portland's Old Port has excellent food — Eventide Oyster Co., Duckfat, Portland Lobster Co. Or take coastal Route 1 through Wiscasset for Red's Eats (legendary lobster roll).

OPTIONAL LUNCH STOP
~4:00 PM

Arrive Southwest Harbor — Check In

9 Dirigo Road. Victorian inn right at the harbor. Yawl room. Breakfast included. The innkeepers are exceptional local guides — ask them everything.

CHECK-IN 4–8 PM
Evening

First Evening at the Harbor

Walk to the harbor before dinner — lobster boats, brine, granite, spruce. Beal's Lobster Pier is a short walk — true Maine pound on a working pier. Maine evenings stay light past 8:30 PM.

MONDAY · JULY 13, 2026

Acadia — Your Pace, Your Day

Southwest Harbor & Acadia National Park
🏞️ No long drives — all within Acadia & MDI
🌅 Sunset ~8:35 PM at Seawall — plan your day around this

Day Schedule

Morning

Breakfast at Harbour Cottage Inn

Included. Take your time. Ask the innkeepers about current tide timing — it matters for Thunder Hole. They know this island cold.

INCLUDED
Mid-Morning

Jordan Pond — Popovers & The View

Crown jewel of Acadia. Glacier-carved pond reflecting the Bubbles — two symmetrical mountains. Jordan Pond House has served famous popovers with jam for 130+ years. Shoreline path is flat and easy.

MUST-SEE · EASY TERRAINPOPOVERS ARE NON-NEGOTIABLE
Early Afternoon

Bass Harbor Head Lighthouse

One of America's most photographed lighthouses — pink granite headland above crashing Atlantic surf. Short easy access path. Extraordinary at any light.

MUST-SEE · TOP PHOTO SPOT
Afternoon

Thunder Hole — Conditions Permitting

Narrow inlet where waves compress into an explosive surge — 40 feet in the air when conditions are right. Best at 3/4 incoming tide. Ask innkeepers.

OPTIONAL · CHECK TIDES
~7:00 PM

Seawall Sunset — The Evening Plan

Flat, easy access to Acadia's western rocky shore. West-facing — sun sets over the water. Bring a blanket and wine. Sunset ~8:35 PM July. Long, golden, unforgettable. Don't miss this.

DO NOT MISS THIS

Also Worth Knowing

EAT
Jordan Pond House
Lunch at the historic restaurant on Jordan Pond — the popovers are the thing, but lunch on the lawn with mountain views is a genuine experience.
EAT
Thurston's Lobster Pound
Bernard, ME — working wharf restaurant on the water. Arguably the best lobster pound experience on MDI. Bring cash.
SEE
Cadillac Mountain Summit
Highest point on the Eastern seaboard. May require advance reservations for the road in summer — check recreation.gov.
SEE
Carriage Roads
45 miles of crushed stone carriage roads built by Rockefeller. Perfect for an easy bike ride or walk through the park.
HIDDEN GEM
Pretty Marsh Picnic Area
Quiet western shore picnic area almost no one knows about. Stunning water views with virtually no crowds.
DETOUR
Schoodic Peninsula
The only mainland section of Acadia — 30 min east. Rocky shoreline, crashing waves, no crowds whatsoever.

TUESDAY · JULY 14, 2026

South Along the Coast to Boston

SW Harbor → Portland Head Light → Boston

🗺 Along the Way — Suggested Stops

Biddeford, ME
Palace Diner — Maine's most celebrated diner, 15 seats, closes mid-afternoon. Only if you get an early start. Otherwise skip and save appetite for the lobster roll.
Palace Diner · Optional Early Stop
Portland, ME
Old Port is worth a 30-min walk — cobblestone streets, excellent shops. Eventide Oyster Co. or Duckfat if you haven't eaten.
Portland · Old Port District
Salem, MA
30 min north of Boston. Witch Trials Memorial, Peabody Essex Museum, Essex Street Pedestrian Mall. Worth 1.5 hrs if energy allows.
Salem · Optional · ~30 min off I-95

Day Schedule

Morning

Final Harbour Cottage Breakfast

Savour this one — last inn breakfast of the trip. Thank the innkeepers. They've earned it. Head south on the coastal drive back toward civilization.

INCLUDED
Mid-Morning

Fort Williams Park — Portland Head Light

Washington commissioned this lighthouse in 1787 — oldest in Maine. Granite headland, Atlantic on three sides, Portland skyline across the bay. Free park. Easy paved paths.

MUST-SEE · DO NOT SKIP
Lunch

Bite Into Maine — The Lobster Roll

Food truck at Fort Williams Park. Maine (cold/mayo) or Connecticut (warm/butter). Connecticut style is outstanding. Eat overlooking the lighthouse and the Atlantic. Trip's best food moment.

BUCKET LIST FOOD MOMENTARRIVE BY 11:15 AM
Afternoon

Salem, MA — Optional Stop

25 miles north of Boston. Witch Trials Memorial, Peabody Essex, Essex Street. Worth 1.5 hrs if energy allows. Skip if tired — no pressure.

OPTIONAL
Evening

Boston — Copley Square & Dinner with Skadz

47 Huntington Ave — Copley Square, Trinity Church, Boston Public Library all steps away. Evening belongs to Skadz — he knows Boston. Trust the local.

Also Worth Knowing

EAT
Eventide Oyster Co.
Portland, ME — James Beard Award winner. Outstanding oysters and the best brown butter lobster roll in New England. Stop on the way south.
EAT
Duckfat
Portland, ME — legendary Belgian fries and paninis. Short wait, worth it. On Middle Street in the Old Port.
SEE
Peabody Essex Museum
Salem — one of America's great art museums. Asian export art collection is world-class. The Chinese house alone is worth stopping for.
SEE
Salem Witch Trials Memorial
Simple and deeply moving memorial on Charter Street. The names carved in granite are unforgettable. 10-minute stop.
HIDDEN GEM
Back Bay Boston
Skadz will know where to eat but suggest a late walk down Newbury Street or around the Public Garden — Boston at night is beautiful.
DETOUR
Pemaquid Point Light
If routing through Damariscotta on Rte 1 — a stunning lighthouse with extraordinary rocky beach. Less famous than Portland Head, equally beautiful.

Road Notes

Mileage Watch

Route ≈ 1,350–1,400 mi. Detours (Salem, Palace Diner, Wiscasset) add up at $0.62/mi. Photo the odometer at pickup and return.

Maine Cell Coverage

Spotty north of Ellsworth and on MDI. Download offline Google Maps for MDI before leaving Hampton. Southwest Harbor has wifi at the inn.

Wine for Seawall

Pick up a bottle in Southwest Harbor or Ellsworth before Acadia day. Bring a wine opener. The Seawall sunset absolutely calls for it.

Bite Into Maine Timing

Opens 11 AM at Fort Williams Park. Arrive by 11:15 to beat the line. Cash accepted. Choose Connecticut style (warm butter). Worth every minute.
